question: What did Rama Krishna believe could turn any metal into real gold? 🪙
explanation: Awesome! Rama Krishna spent a lot of time looking for a magic potion that he believed could turn ordinary things into gold! 🧪
hint: It is a liquid that is believed to have magical powers.

question: What was the name of Rama Krishna's supportive wife? 👩
explanation: Great job! Madhumati was Rama Krishna's wife who worried about him but always helped him manage their home! 🏡
hint: Her name starts with the letter M and means sweet like honey.

question: Who was the wise sage that Rama Krishna went to meet for help? 🧔
explanation: Excellent! Sage Mahipati was the famous wise man who decided to teach Rama Krishna a valuable lesson about hard work! 🌟
hint: His name starts with M and he lived up in the hills.

question: Where did the wise Sage Mahipati live? ⛰️
explanation: Wonderful! The sage lived quietly up in the hills where people visited him for his great wisdom! 🌲
hint: It is a high, natural place with trees and fresh air.

question: According to the sage, what was the secret ingredient needed for the magic potion? 💧
explanation: Fantastic! The sage told Rama Krishna that he needed to collect morning dew from banana leaves to make the magic potion! 🍃
hint: These are tiny drops of water found on large green leaves early in the morning.

question: How many liters of morning dew did the sage ask Rama Krishna to collect? 🧪
explanation: Superb! The sage asked for exactly five liters of morning dew, which requires a lot of patience to collect! 🧪
hint: It is the number of fingers on one hand.

question: To collect the dew, what plants did Rama Krishna have to grow? 🍌
explanation: Magnificent! He had to plant and take care of banana plants because their large leaves hold dew beautifully! 🍃
hint: This plant gives us a long, sweet, yellow fruit that monkeys love.

question: Who had to plant and look after the banana fields all by himself? 👨‍🌾
explanation: Amazing! Rama Krishna himself worked hard in the fields, digging the soil and planting the bananas! 🌾
hint: He is the main character of the story who wanted to find gold.

question: How many years did it take for Rama Krishna to collect enough dew? 🗓️
explanation: Brilliant! It took Rama Krishna six long years of continuous hard work to collect all five liters of dew! 🗓️
hint: It is a number greater than five but less than seven.

question: While Rama Krishna collected dew, what did his wife Madhumati do with the bananas? 🍌
options: She sold them in the market 🪙
answer: She sold them in the market 🪙
explanation: Great job! Madhumati was very smart; she gathered the bananas from the plantation and sold them to earn money! 💰
hint: She turned the fruits of his labor into a real business.

question: How did Rama Krishna feel when he finally collected all 5 liters of dew? 🎉
explanation: Awesome! He felt joyful because he believed his long years of hard work would finally give him the magic potion! 🧪
hint: It is the feeling you get when you win a prize or complete a big puzzle.

question: When Rama Krishna brought the dew, what did the sage do to test it? ✨
options: He chanted a spell and poured it on a copper vessel 🏺
He spilled it on the floor 🧹
answer: He chanted a spell and poured it on a copper vessel 🏺
explanation: Excellent! The sage chanted a magic spell and poured the dew over a copper object to show Rama Krishna what would happen! 🏺
hint: He used a special container made of red-brown metal.

question: Did the copper vessel turn into gold when the dew was poured on it? 🏺
explanation: Wonderful! The vessel did not change into gold because there is no such thing as a magic potion that changes metal! 💡
hint: The potion did not work because real magic lies elsewhere.

question: How did Rama Krishna feel when the copper did not turn into gold? 😞
explanation: Fantastic! He felt sad because he thought all his hard work over six years had gone to waste! 💔
hint: It is how you feel when something you really hoped for does not come true.

question: To show Rama Krishna his true wealth, who did the sage call into the room? 👩
explanation: Superb! The sage called Madhumati inside because she held the true surprise of their hard work! 🪙
hint: She was his life partner who managed the banana sales.

question: What did Madhumati carry inside the room to surprise Rama Krishna? 📦
options: A box full of gold coins 🪙
answer: A box full of gold coins 🪙
explanation: Magnificent! She brought in a heavy box full of gold coins that she earned by selling the bananas over six years! 🪙
hint: It was filled with shiny, round, valuable treasures.

question: Where did all the wealth and gold coins come from? 🍌
options: From selling bananas from their plantation 🍌
From a gift from the king 👑
answer: From selling bananas from their plantation 🍌
explanation: Amazing! The wealth was created because Rama Krishna grew thousands of bananas while trying to collect the dew! 🌾
hint: It came from the hard work done in the fields every day.

question: What was the valuable lesson that the wise sage taught Rama Krishna? 💡
options: Hard work is the true magic that creates wealth 🛠️
Sleeping all day makes you rich 🛌
answer: Hard work is the true magic that creates wealth 🛠️
explanation: Brilliant! The sage showed him that there is no magic potion, and only honest, steady labor creates fortune! 🌟
hint: It means using your own hands and efforts to achieve success.

question: What did Rama Krishna do at the end of the story? 👨‍🌾
options: He continued to look after his banana plantation 👨‍🌾
He went to look for another sage 🧔
answer: He continued to look after his banana plantation 👨‍🌾
explanation: Great job! Rama Krishna understood the lesson and happily kept working in his beautiful fields! 🍌
hint: He stayed back to take care of the plants that made him successful.

question: What type of story is 'A Bottle of Dew'? 📖
explanation: Awesome! This story gives us a wonderful life lesson about moving away from illusions and focusing on real efforts! 🌟
hint: It teaches us how we should behave and work in real life.

question: What did Rama Krishna do in his youth instead of working properly? 💭
options: He wasted time and money chasing magic tricks 💭
answer: He wasted time and money chasing magic tricks 💭
explanation: Excellent! In his early days, he didn't focus on real work because he was too busy trying to find easy ways to get rich! 🪙
hint: He ran behind things that were not real.

question: How did Madhumati feel about her husband's initial obsession with magic? 😟
explanation: Wonderful! She was deeply concerned because they were losing their property while he chased illusions! 🏡

question: What season is best known for creating beautiful morning dew? ❄️
explanation: Fantastic! Dew drops form best when the air is cool and moist, typically during the winter months! 💧
hint: It is the chilly time of the year when we wear sweaters.

question: Why did the sage not tell Rama Krishna directly that magic is fake? 🤔

answer: He wanted him to learn through experience and action 🤔
explanation: Superb! A good teacher allows students to practice and realize the truth by themselves! 🎓
hint: It means learning by doing the work instead of just listening.

question: What did Rama Krishna use to carefully store the dew drops? 🍾
explanation: Magnificent! He used a bottle to make sure every single drop of precious dew was kept safely! 💧
hint: The title of the chapter mentions this specific container.

question: What word best describes Rama Krishna's attitude during the six years of farming? 🦁

question: What color are healthy, growing banana leaves? 🟢

question: What happened to the size of Rama Krishna's plantation over the years? 📈

hint: It increased in size because of his continuous planting.

question: The gold coins earned by Madhumati were a result of whose wisdom? 🧠
options: The wise advice of Sage Mahipati and Madhumati's smart work 🧠
answer: The wise advice of Sage Mahipati and Madhumati's smart work 🧠
explanation: Awesome! The clever trick of the sage and the intelligence of his wife combined to save the family! 🌟
hint: It took two thoughtful minds to help change Rama Krishna's path.

question: What does 'Dew' look like when the sun shines on it? ✨
explanation: Excellent! Early in the morning, light makes dew drops shimmer beautifully just like little diamonds on leaves! 💎

He became famous as a singer 🎤
answer: He was respected as a wealthy and wise farmer 🎖️

question: Why did the sage say he could not make the potion himself? 🧔

question: What did Rama Krishna realize when he looked at his wife's box of coins? 💡
options: He realized that his hard work had already made him rich 💡

question: What did Rama Krishna do to the soil before planting the banana trees? 🌱

answer: There are no magic shortcuts to real success 🛑

question: How did Rama Krishna treat his banana plants? 💕

answer: He looked after them with great love and care 💕
